map.→ 打开锚地容量设计工具: -> Open the Anchorage Capacity Design tool
map.圆形和方格布局怎么选？: How Do You Choose Between Circular and Grid Layouts?
map.圆形旋回锚泊与方格固定泊位两种布局对比：前者各船独立旋回互不干扰但占地大，后者布: Comparison of the two layouts, circular swing anchoring and grid fixed berthing: in the former each vessel swings independently without interference but takes more space, while in the latter berthing is compact but the swing radius must be tightly controlled so it does not cross the boundary.
map.圆形旋回锚泊各船以锚为中心独立旋回、互不干扰，单船占地 πR²（R 为旋回半径）: With circular swing anchoring each vessel swings independently around its anchor without interference, occupying πR² per vessel (R is the swing radius); grid fixed berthing is compact (spacing 2R) but requires each swing to stay within bounds, so it suits a well-organized fixed-berth anchorage.
map.开阔水域与遮蔽水域选择出链倍数（通常 4–7 倍水深），评估大风/强流下的安全余: Choose a scope ratio for open or sheltered water (usually 4 to 7 times the depth) and assess whether the safety margin in strong wind or current is sufficient and whether dragging is likely.
map.输入单船锚泊旋回半径与锚地水域尺寸，计算所需锚泊面积与锚地可安全容纳的船舶数量，: Enter the swing radius of a single anchored vessel and the size of the anchorage area to compute the required anchorage area and the number of vessels the anchorage can safely hold, for port anchorage planning and navigation safety.
map.遮蔽水域可低至 3–4 倍水深，开阔或大风水域建议 ≥6 倍（本工具判定 >7: In sheltered water the scope can be as low as 3 to 4 times the depth; for open or windy/fast-flowing water a ratio of 6 or more is recommended (this tool judges above 7 times as suitable for harsh conditions). Too short a scope leaves an insufficient swing radius and makes dragging likely in strong wind; too long takes up more space and increases anchor chain wear.
map.锚地可容船舶数示例: Example of the Number of Vessels an Anchorage Can Hold
map.锚地规划或港口扩容评估时，用本工具按船长、水深、出链倍数与安全余量推算单船旋回半: When planning an anchorage or assessing port expansion, use this tool to derive the swing radius and occupied area per vessel from the ship length, the depth, the scope ratio, and the safety margin, and estimate how many vessels the anchorage can hold.
map.：某锚地 10 km²、船长 200 m、水深 20 m、出链 5 倍、安全余量: : For an anchorage of 10 km² with ship length 200 m, depth 20 m, a scope ratio of 5, a 50 m safety margin, and a circular layout: the scope length = 20×5 = 100 m; the swing radius = 100 + 200 + 50 = 350 m; the area per vessel = π×350² ≈ 384845 m²; the vessels it can hold = ⌊10×10⁶ ÷ 384845⌋ = 25. With a grid layout instead (berth spacing 2×350 = 700 m), the area per vessel is 700² = 490000 m², and it can hold ⌊10×10⁶÷490000⌋ = 20 vessels, so the circular layout saves land but you must avoid anchor chain entanglement.
